text: Le formulaire New/Edit Policy utilise deux textbox sans label accessible (dates From/to) et plusieurs spinbutton portant tous « Amount in CHF », impossibles à cibler séparément avec les locators permis; ne pas soumettre des tests qui les remplissent. Le détail de la police fvo5pkqerr est accessible; les demandes de devis ouvertes incluent la date 18. Nov 2026 21:29, id 34. Rejeter cette demande pendant l’exploration la modifie durablement, maintenant rejetée.

Policy Management policy contracts are visible in Customer Self-Service: /policies displays the customer’s owned policy details and quote request list. The local quote request was submitted from Customer Self-Service and appeared in Policy Management’s open requests after switching apps. Current policy screen has three identical unlabeled  buttons; cannot target those uniquely.

In Policy Management edit/create forms, repeated controls are not uniquely accessible: three spinbuttons share the exact accessible name “Amount in CHF” and dates lack accessible labels. Harness cannot use nth/positional locators; do not plan data-entry saves requiring those fields. Quote response Reject workflow works with uniquely locatable radio and buttons. Request details can be opened directly by /insurance-quote-requests/{id}.

Customer Management search filters by customer name only (partial first/last name); searching the full name "Ado Kinnett" returns 0 while "Ado" or "Kinnett" finds the customer. Profile edit succeeds with Save Changes; restore any changed existing customer data after write scenarios (the environment data is shared).

Customer Management and Policy Management share customer profiles: after updating Ado Kinnett in Customer Management (ID bunlo9vk5f), Policy Management /customers/bunlo9vk5f displays the changed address, email and phone. The Customer Management-to-Policy Management button did not navigate in the observed UI, so use separate application goto for cross-app verification.

Customer Self-Service demo login is shown on /login: click “Fill in” populates admin@example.com / 1password, then “Log in” opens /policies. Submitting a quote is persistent/write: the policies list gains a new “Waiting for Quote” row and Policy Management displays it. Quote form defaults contact address to Oberseestrasse 11, 8640 Rapperswil; date/types/deductibles selectable; submitting will create shared data.

Policy Management quote-response form has two spinbuttons both named “Amount in CHF” with no distinguishable locator, so premium/limit fields cannot safely be filled by tests. Customer Self-Service list has many identical rows (same date, insurance type, status); clicking a specific request row is ambiguous. Existing cross-app test only verifies submitted request appears in Policy Management; response-to-customer effect remains separate coverage need.

Quote workflow visual states explored: Customer Self-Service demo login admin@example.com / 1password; sign-in at /login lands on /policies. Existing quote journey tests create requests, so new visuals should reuse existing request instead of writing shared data. Request list has many duplicate rows; Policy detail request /insurance-quote-requests/49 is unanswered. On its Respond dialog, two Amount in CHF spinbuttons have no distinguishing label/test id, making them unusable as unique locators.
